reference_author: AI; source-grounded under user delegated candidate resolution
selection_policy: Five directly stated business-controller obligations with explicit before/prior-to evidence and two distinct process events, independently constructible without a national-law choice. Selected before any new predictions. This is a scoped excerpt benchmark, not the full 46-article Sun checking experiment.
evaluation_scope: Checking on independently specified applicable regulation-process pairs; predict all five rules for every current BPMN, then evaluate the specified scope in a separate evaluator. No claim of automatic end-to-end rule selection or complete GDPR compliance. Matching scores may be stored, but no MAP without independent complete relevance reference.
mutation_policy: One control and one missing-action, incorrect-process-executor, and reversed-order variant per source requirement. No post-result case selection. The process-level executor mutation is visible to both native Winter and Sun representations. One semantic violated requirement per variant within the declared scope.
reference_states: When the mandatory activity is absent, executor and precedence are not_applicable, not negative. For every other case all three checks have explicit reference states. Method unknowns remain in the fixed evaluable population, including false negatives on positive references.

rules.locator_prefix: Where the controller intends to further process
rules.citation: GDPR Article 13(3), with Article 13(4) applicability context
rules.applicability_zh: 数据直接从本人获得；控制者决定改用于新目的；本人尚不知道新目的及相关补充信息；本例评价第13(3)款的告知与先后要求，不评价整个第13条的信息收集环节。
rules.start_label: Direct collection completed; new processing purpose proposed; notice not yet given
tasks: Document the new processing purpose
Inform the data subject of the new purpose and relevant transparency information
Process personal data for the new purpose
Record completion of the processing

rules.locator_prefix: Where the controller intends to further process
rules.citation: GDPR Article 14(4), with Article 14(5) applicability context
rules.applicability_zh: 数据来自第三方；控制者计划用于另一目的；本人尚不知道该信息；可以合理提供信息，且不存在法定取得/披露或保密例外；本例仅评价第14(4)款。
rules.start_label: Indirect collection completed; new purpose proposed; no transparency exemption applies
tasks: Review the proposed secondary use of third-party data
Provide the data subject with the other purpose and relevant additional information
Further process the personal data for the other purpose
Log the completed secondary use

rules.locator_prefix: A data subject who has obtained restriction
rules.applicability_zh: 本人已依据第18(1)款取得处理限制；解除条件已满足；控制者准备解除限制；本例只评价解除前由控制者告知的义务。
rules.order_marker: before the restriction of processing is lifted
rules.obligation_evidence: shall be informed by the controller
rules.start_label: Processing restricted under Article 18(1); grounds for lifting restriction confirmed
tasks: Record the decision to lift the restriction
Inform the data subject that the processing restriction will be lifted
Lift the restriction of processing
Archive the restriction handling record

rules.locator_prefix: Where a type of processing in particular using new technologies
rules.applicability_zh: 拟开展的处理很可能对自然人权利自由造成高风险；不适用免做评估情形；本例将完整评估作为一个业务活动，只评价第35(1)款开展评估及其先后，不评价评估文档内容质量。
rules.start_label: High-risk processing proposed; data protection impact assessment required
tasks: Describe the envisaged high-risk processing
Carry out the data protection impact assessment of the envisaged processing
Begin the assessed processing operations
Store the assessment reference

rules.locator_prefix: The controller shall consult the supervisory authority prior to processing
rules.applicability_zh: 第35条评估已在本流程开始前完成，表明无缓解措施时有高风险；本例只评价第36(1)款控制者事先咨询义务，不评价咨询材料或监管机关随后采取的措施。
rules.start_label: Impact assessment completed; high risk without mitigation requires prior consultation
tasks: Review the impact assessment requiring consultation
Consult the supervisory authority about the proposed processing
Start the proposed processing
Retain the consultation record

source_selection_exclusions.reason: Short passive sentence relies on wider consent context for actor; existing article-level reference has no endorsed order edge. Existing Gold unchanged.
Prohibition and written-authorisation precondition; cannot silently relabel as an obligation under the frozen obligation-only converter.
Contract-content clauses, legal exceptions and deletion/return alternatives require broader reference than this initial directly stated controller-obligation scope.
Conditional permission for transfer is not an unconditional mandatory action.

release_gate.extreme_f1_handling: Retain actual predictions and metrics; investigate implementation and scope. Never clip scores, tune on this benchmark, alter references, or remove cases to avoid 0/1.
